name: Kaladesh
description: Kaladesh is a plane of aether and invention, Chandra's home plane and Saheeli's, whose largest city is Ghirapur.

status.text: The latest events in the material show Huatli's earlier meeting with Saheeli on Kaladesh, while later pages describe the plane as under attack and renamed Avishkar after the revolution.

citations.text: "Note for a Stranger" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Chandra planeswalks back to Kaladesh for the first time since she left.
timeline.quote: Before she could take a deep, soothing breath, though, she had arrived.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Avaati Vya cracks the aether code, developing a refinement process that separates aether's energy-rich part from its volatile part.
timeline.quote: Six decades ago, the world-renowned aetherologist Avaati Vya cracked the aether code.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: The Consulate develops mass production and distribution of refined aether, with airships and pipelines.
timeline.quote: The Consulate developed methods for mass production and distribution of refined aether.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Plane-wide availability of aether spurs the Great Aether Boom, a time of frenzied invention.
timeline.quote: It was a time of frenzied invention, boundless hope, and wondrous celebration.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: The renegades come to defy the Consulate, believing it conceals information and oppresses the public.
timeline.quote: These renegades defy the Consulate as they attempt to restore the independence they believe they deserve.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Dovin Baan, having exhausted Kaladesh's resources against a self-described renegade, decides to call on the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Dovin sees no other choice but to reach outside his world and call on other Planeswalkers

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra hears from Dovin Baan that Kaladesh is threatened and returns home for the first time since her parents' deaths.
timeline.quote: She returns home for the first time since her parents' deaths.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa follows her friend Chandra to Kaladesh to help.
timeline.quote: Nissa follows to help.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Huatli arrives in a bustling inventors' city on Kaladesh.
timeline.quote: She emerged into a city unlike any she had seen before.

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Saheeli names the plane Kaladesh and the city Ghirapur.
timeline.quote: This plane is Kaladesh, and this city is Ghirapur.

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: On her way to the tavern, Huatli runs into Saheeli, whom she met on Kaladesh on her first planeswalk, and rushes off without confessing her feelings.
timeline.quote: "I have to go," Huatli adds, interrupting whatever Saheeli was about to say.

citation.text: "Note for a Stranger" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2022.

timeline.summary: On Kaladesh, Pia Nalaar braces for death on a platform when the Phyrexians suddenly crumble and she thanks Chandra.
timeline.quote: All over Ghirapur it is the same: the Phyrexians are falling.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 10: The Rhythms of Life
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 10: The Rhythms of Life" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Mohar says a powerful mind mage has agreed to help him.
timeline.quote: A powerful mind mage has agreed to lend us his assistance with

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Mohar asks his old friend Rudra, now in the barracks, to help restore Kaladesh by force.
timeline.quote: I need a force to put an end to the race.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Mohar says no revolution worth having has been bloodless, accepting a bloody trap at the finish line.
timeline.quote: No revolution worth having has ever been bloodless.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch and Ajani support the Renegades while searching for Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: The Gatewatch and Ajani Goldmane support the renegades

citation.text: "Aether Revolt", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Baral taunts Chandra Nalaar to lure her away from the rest of the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Disallow depicts Baral's taunting of Chandra Nalaar in an attempt to lure her away from the rest of the Gatewatch.

citation.text: "Aether Revolt", section "Story Spotlight cards". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ajani rescues Oviya, Nissa and Chandra from a gas-filled cell in the Dhund.
timeline.quote: he forced the chamber door open, finding Oviya as well as Nissa and Chandra

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ajani joins the Gatewatch after the Renegade victory.
timeline.quote: He took his oath to protect the innocent from tyrants and to help all beings find their place

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In a flashback to her youth on Kaladesh, Chandra sets off a huge blast of fire to scare off her parents and runs away to the mountains.
timeline.quote: In an attempt to scare off her parents, she set off a huge blast of fire that caught several of the village huts on fire, before running away to the mountains.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Facing execution after her village is burned, Chandra's spark ignites and she planeswalks to Regatha for the first time.
timeline.quote: This traumatic moment ignited her Planeswalker spark, sending her to Regatha

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The page says Chandra's account was not the whole truth: the soldiers of the Consuls lit the fire in the village.
timeline.quote: The fire in the village wasn't lit by Chandra but by the soldiers of the Consuls, who were persecuting her.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Revised origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Avaati Vya refines raw aether, the Consulate distributes it, leading to an inventors' renaissance.
timeline.quote: Their efforts led to a plane-wide inventors' renaissance

citation.text: "Consulate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Warned by Chandra and Saheeli, Kaladesh resists the Phyrexians with Project Golden Scale, and Dhiren Baral is released to help.
timeline.quote: Dhiren Baral was released from prison to assist with the defense.

citation.text: "Consulate", section "New Phyrexiam Invasion of Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The new Consulate forgives all of Baral's previous transgressions.
timeline.quote: the new Consulate forgave all of Baral's previous transgressions

citation.text: "Consulate", section "Rebuilding and the Indigo Revolution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Indigo Revolution removes the Consulate; the Avishkar Assembly is installed and renames the plane Avishkar.
timeline.quote: the Consulate was removed from power in the Indigo Revolution

citation.text: "Consulate", section "Rebuilding and the Indigo Revolution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kari Zev rescues Baral and forces him to join her, with Ragavan watching him.
timeline.quote: Kari Zev assigned her trusted First Mate Ragavan to keep a close watch on Baral

citation.text: "Dhiren Baral", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The new Consulate overlooks Baral's past offenses because of his defense of Kaladesh.
timeline.quote: the new Consulate chose to overlook Baral’s prior offenses and transgressions

citation.text: "Dhiren Baral", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Baan asks the Gatewatch for aid against the renegade threat but is refused.
timeline.quote: he requested the aid of the Gatewatch .

citation.text: "Dovin Baan", section "Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret arrests Renegade Prime (Pia Nalaar), and Baan orders gearhulks to isolate Chandra, but Pia surrenders.
timeline.quote: Renegade Prime, however, relented and let herself be taken into custody.

citation.text: "Dovin Baan", section "Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During Tezzeret's coup Baan hesitantly cooperates and is promised leadership of the institution manufacturing the streamlined inventions, in exchange for dealing with the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret demanded that Dovin Baan take care of the Gatewatch since it was due to his invitation that they were here.

citation.text: "Dovin Baan", section "Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Baan advises encircling the Aether Hub, identifies Chandra as the Gatewatch's weakest link, and Tezzeret orders Baral to distract her.
timeline.quote: Baan stated that the weakest link of the group was Chandra Nalaar, due to her impulsiveness.

citation.text: "Dovin Baan", section "Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: When the Renegades attack the Spire, Baan sabotages the Hope of Ghirapur and planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Baan boarded the Heart of Kiran and sabotaged the Hope of Ghirapur

citation.text: "Dovin Baan", section "Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch confronts Tezzeret at the arena; he ends the Inventor's Fair and retreats, having used them as a distraction.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret announced the end of the Inventor's Fair and retreated to a skyship

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ajani joins the Gatewatch after they aid the Renegades' rebellion.
timeline.quote: They were helped by Ajani Goldmane , who afterward joined the team.

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Kaladesh, Gideon clashes with Chandra and Liliana over how the Gatewatch should treat the Consulate.
timeline.quote: Gideon reminded her that the purpose of the Gatewatch was not traveling from plane to plane to impose their judgment

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon destroys a Gearhulk with his indestructible body, then he and Chandra destroy the planar bridge from inside a thopter; Tezzeret escapes.
timeline.quote: He destroyed the Gearhulk by placing his indestructible body between the gears, causing it to collapse.

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "The Aether Revolt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon inducts Ajani into the Gatewatch.

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "The Aether Revolt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dovin and Nissa travel to Kaladesh, gather Consulate reinforcements and find Tezzeret confronting Pia, Liliana and Chandra.

citation.text: "Inventors' Fair", section "Crackdown on renegades". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
